nodes.label: Cognitive Load
nodes.rationale: Overloaded users make mistakes and leave; distinguish intrinsic task complexity from extraneous waste caused by bad design and preserve germane learning effort.

nodes.label: Working Memory Rule
nodes.rationale: Humans hold <=4 items in working memory (Cowan revision of Miller); exceed it and users skip, misclick, or abandon.

nodes.label: Progressive Disclosure
nodes.rationale: Reveal complexity only when needed to manage intrinsic load and support germane learning without overwhelming working memory.
